pages.text: The $(l)Repair Talisman$() slowly repairs your gear. Craft it from the three covalence dusts, string and paper. It fits the belt curio slot.

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)Every 10 seconds it repairs one durability point on every damaged, repairable item you carry, for 4 EMC per point.$(li)$(l)In this version it only works while equipped in the belt curio slot$(); it no longer repairs straight from your backpack.$(li)It does not repair items that have modes, such as the mod's own tools, and it will not repair your attacking weapon while you are swinging.$(li)It also still repairs items while stored inside an Alchemical Bag or Alchemical Chest, and on a pedestal it repairs nearby players' gear on a timer.
